data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €669
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterweiler issued your income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, dated 28 July 2026. It results in a refund of €669.00, to be transferred to your account.
data.explanation: Your 2025 tax return was assessed. More income tax was withheld through your payslips (€7,540) than was due (€6,871), so you get €669 back. Nothing needs to be paid. Check that the figures match your return. The office applied the commuting allowance for 196 working days and the home-office flat rate for the other claimed days. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch); the app shows the deadline. If unsure, a tax adviser or an income tax help association (Lohnsteuerhilfeverein) can help.
data.tax_note: This is your income tax assessment for 2025; keep it as proof of assessed income, deductions and the refund.

items.title: Objection against tax assessment (optional)
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with Finanzamt Musterweiler, or declare it there for the record.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final and can no longer be contested.
items.quote: Mit dem Einspruch können Sie diesen Bescheid anfechten, und zwar binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe.

items.title: Tax refund incoming

date.text: Wir überweisen den Betrag auf Ihr Konto DE72 2605 0001 0044 1029 38.
